title: MChallengeTimer
description: A fully configurable challenge timer plugin for Minecraft with customizable settings, modern systems, and optimized performance.
body:
# MChallengeTimer

MChallengeTimer is a powerful and fully customizable timer plugin designed for Minecraft challenges, events, SMPs, and hardcore gameplay.

Whether you are creating YouTube challenges, community events, speedruns, or survival competitions, this plugin gives you complete control over your timer system.

Simple to use, lightweight, and highly optimized for modern Minecraft servers.

## Features

* Fully configurable challenge timer
* Start, pause, resume, and reset functions
* Custom timer formats
* Live timer display
* Scoreboard support
* Adjustable messages and settings
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Modern and clean system design
* Stable and efficient code
* Easy setup and usage

## Included Systems

### Timer System

Flexible timer management for all kinds of Minecraft challenges.

### Scoreboard Support

Display the challenge timer live on a scoreboard.

### Customization

Configure messages, formats, displays, and behavior exactly how you want.

### Event Support

Perfect for public events, YouTube videos, SMPs, and competitions.

## Why Choose MChallengeTimer?

* Perfect for challenge content
* Lightweight and optimized
* Easy to configure
* Modern design
* Reliable and stable
* Designed for modern Minecraft versions

## Use Cases

* YouTube Challenges
* SMP Events
* Hardcore Challenges
* Speedruns
* Community Competitions
* Survival Events
